newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products softer with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products softer with crude.

text.p: NWE oil products were softer with crude on Monday, traders said.
Gasoline remained depressed by weaker futures and slack demand, but ARA barges saw tight refinery Rotterdam supplies taking a $2-3 premiums to general ARA liftings.
Naphtha prices were slightly weaker in line with crude and traders said the market looked oversupplied heading into the second half of November.
Gas oil premiums were talked around $1 lower on slack demand with nervousness over last week's record IPE delivery again slowing business.
Fuel oil barges were slightly weaker with crude, but high sulphur cargoes were supported by an arbitrage to the United States.
